Callout.Name: Medical Emergency - Inmate
Callout.Advisory: Conscious but unwell, staff on scene, no violence.

Script.Line: I came over dizzy in the workshop. It came on out of nowhere.
I have not felt right since breakfast. Nobody else has been ill.
Do not take me to the wing. Anything but the wing.

Callout.Patient: I came over dizzy. I have not felt right since breakfast.

Lines.Approach: They went down in the workshop and the staff have them sitting up. They want the ambulance and so do I.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
